notes: Registration input for the W5 minute panel (run-panel-build-w5.json) as its own source, panel-minute-w5; the W4 source is untouched. Registration input, not a run input: publishes the W4 minute panel (run-panel-build-w4.json) back through onboarding as its OWN source, `panel-minute-w4`, so the earlier source `panel-minute` and its snapshot, which every W1/W2 result names, are untouched.
